description: Phase A-01 expected-failure baseline (A0-T1/T2/T3 authority probes). These are NOT Phase 0 legacy failures: they are the concrete authority-chain defects that Phase A0 located and that Issues #2/#4 must fix one by one. This file is consumed by run_tests.ps1 -BaselineExtra so the full matrix can show them as DECLARED Phase A expected failures while keeping each case status FAIL (never PASS, never skipped, never hidden). The Phase 0 file game_v17/tests/known_baseline_failures.json is NOT touched by Phase A.
baseline_commit_note: GitHub main merge 'Merge Phase A0 physics and information authority audit'; probes added on top of it in this PR without touching runtime code.
related: docs/55_PhaseA0_物理与信息权威基线调查.md
evidence_provenance: Independently executed on base 4b0b102 with the real product entry (main_menu -> v1_hud -> ShellBinder -> GameSession, DSH_BUILD=orbital_sim). Counts are deterministic across repeated runs. Every entry is a real authority-chain defect located by the Phase A0 audit, NOT an accepted regression.
notes: These entries must remain FAIL until Issues #2/#4 fix the underlying authority chain. Refreshing expected_pass/expected_fail is allowed only together with a runtime fix that legitimately changes the counts.
Phase 0 gate semantics are unchanged: -Gate phase0 never reads this file.
This file must never be merged into game_v17/tests/known_baseline_failures.json.

failures.reason: A0-T1: fused track range is still computed from the static SensorService target config (harmattan 20 km, l1_station 10 km) instead of the unified PhysicsWorld truth (420.20 km / 90.00 km), so the track-vs-truth range error is ~400 km / ~80 km against the required <= 0.5 km. All other A0-T1 checks pass: same-tick timestamps (1e-6 s), evidence-derived identity, threat consistency (no unauthorized hostile), contact side semantics, provenance, TrackTable single writer, bary_rot/km units.
failures.defect_ref: A0 audit C1 (track truth authority); Issue #2
failures.suggested_follow_up: Issue #4.1 sensor target geometry binding to PhysicsWorld (see stacked PR #20) then re-baseline this probe

failures.reason: A0-T2: entity static metadata (side/identity/batch/rcs_m2/radius_km/has_pd) is not carried through PhysicsWorld -> WorldState -> snapshot -> track -> contacts; 126 authority-layer violations (PhysicsWorld/WorldState/snapshot must match scenario truth exactly, unknown is NOT excused there) + 77 projection-layer violations (track/contacts; only side/identity may be unknown and only with a verified no-identity-evidence reason). Contacts additionally fall back to side=friend / identity=friend for 6 of 7 rows, i.e. a silent friend fallback instead of an explicit unknown.
failures.defect_ref: A0 audit C2/C3 (metadata pipeline, silent friend fallback); Issue #2
failures.suggested_follow_up: Issue #2 entity metadata authority (stacked PR #17) then re-baseline this probe

failures.reason: A0-T3: (a) the live HUD session save->load fails with replay 'send_comms' no_route; (b) event seq drifts int -> float through the JSON save roundtrip (1.0/2.0/... instead of 1/2/...), 10 occurrences across save payload + loaded bus; (c) the save payload has no sensor_service runtime snapshot; (d) SensorService EMCON/radar state and the full channel content are therefore lost on load. The fixture explicitly toggles EMCON to the opposite of its initial value before saving (asserted to have actually changed) and holds 3 non-empty channels (radar.tws/optical/ir); the roundtrip compares normalized full channel content, not just a count. physics/world/track numeric roundtrip (<=1e-9), identification int config and save->load->save canonical equality all pass.
failures.defect_ref: A0 audit C4/C5 (int->float drift, sensor runtime state not persisted); Issue #2
failures.suggested_follow_up: Issue #2 save/load authority persistence then re-baseline this probe
